entries.title: Public Holidays Act 2010 No 115 (NSW)
entries.notes: The statute behind the holidays ASX Trade observes: New Year's Day, Australia Day, Good Friday, Easter Monday, Anzac Day, the Sovereign's Birthday (second Monday in June), Christmas Day and Boxing Day, with the additional-day rules (New Year's Day, Christmas Day and Boxing Day on a weekend: an additional holiday on the following Monday or Tuesday; Australia Day on a weekend: the following Monday instead; Anzac Day: 25 April whatever the weekday). The site blocks automated retrieval, so the rules are quoted from the NSW Government's own summaries (nsw-public-holidays-page, nsw-public-holidays-2021-2023). ASX trades on the NSW-only Labour Day and Bank Holiday.

entries.title: NSW public holidays (2026 and 2027 tables with Additional Day rows; FAQ on Anzac Day, Australia Day and the Bank Holiday)
entries.covers: 2026-01-01 to 2027-12-31 (NSW public holidays, not exchange days)
entries.notes: States the Act's observance rules: "The Anzac Day holiday is always recognised and observed on the 25 April every year. This includes when it falls on a weekend."; "Where Australia Day falls on a weekend, there is no public holiday on that day. Instead, the following Monday is the public holiday."; New Year's Day, Christmas Day or Boxing Day on a weekend bring "an additional gazetted public holiday on the following available weekday"; the Bank Holiday "is not a declared public holiday". Lists the one-off Additional Days Monday 27 April 2026 and Monday 26 April 2027, which the exchange did not observe (asx-trade-calendar-2026-2027).

entries.title: NSW Public Holidays 2021-2023 (NSW Industrial Relations table, Transport for NSW open-data copy)

entries.title: ASX Trade calendar (live page: 2026 and 2027 tables)
entries.notes: The exchange's cash-market calendar: every non-trading day and every CLOSE EARLY day with the footnote "Normal trading ceases at 14:10 (Sydney time)". 2027 prints "ANZAC Day Monday 26 April OPEN - Substitute for Sunday 25 April" and 2026 lists Saturday 25 April CLOSED with no Monday row, so the exchange trades on NSW's additional Anzac Day holidays. Any weekday not listed is a trading day.

entries.title: Trading Days, Business Days & Settlement Activity for 2017 (notice 1357.16.11, 15 November 2016)
entries.notes: Changes the early-close rule: "From 2017 ASX will only close early when the last trading day before Christmas and New Year's Holidays are the respective Eve of these holidays. As such ASX trade will not observe an early close on the 22nd or 29th December 2017." The 2017 calendar attachment is no longer served.

entries.notes: "trading hours on Friday 23 December 2016 and Friday 30 December will be shortened in accordance with usual practice"; closing single price auction at 14:10:30. The last documented year of the pre-2017 practice of shortening the last trading day before Christmas and the last trading day of the year whatever their dates.

entries.title: ASX Trade Outage - 19 September 2016 (notice 1111.16.09)
entries.notes: The exchange's timeline: "At 9.45am ASX announced the market would not open on schedule and was placed into Enquire"; staggered opening from 11:30; "At 2.05pm ASX placed the entire market back into Enquire"; "At 3.35pm ASX announced that the market would not re-open and that there would be no CSPA"; closing prices were the last traded prices.

entries.title: ASX media alert on the ASX Trade outage, 19 September 2016
entries.notes: "The primary issue arose from a hardware failure in the main database used by the system"; consequences "included a delay to the market open and the decision to close the market early".

entries.title: ASIC 16-352MR: statement on review of ASX technical failure on 19 September 2016
entries.notes: "This caused a delay to the market opening and an early market close".

entries.title: ASX Market Outage, 16 November 2020 (incident report, 4 December 2020)
entries.notes: "The market was closed from 10:24:05 on 16 November 2020." "All markets on ASX Trade were placed in an ENQUIRE Session State at 10:24:05. They remained in ENQUIRE for the rest of the trading day until 18:50".

entries.title: Message from ASX about the ASX Trade outage, 16 November 2020
entries.notes: "The market will remain closed today, Monday 16 November. It will reopen at the normal time (10am) tomorrow, Tuesday 17 November."

entries.title: ASX Trade market outage notice, 16 November 2020 (notice 1469.20.11)
entries.notes: "All trades executed and reported today are valid": the 24 minutes of trading stand, so the day is an early termination rather than a closure.

entries.title: ASIC 20-284MR: statement on ASX equity market outage
entries.notes: ASX "did not reopen for trading today Monday, 16 November 2020, after an outage occurred during the opening auction".

entries.title: ASX cash market trading days by month, January 2010 - September 2026 (table compiled from the ASX Group Monthly Activity Reports)
entries.notes: One row per month: the exchange's printed "Total trading days" for the cash market, the financial-year-to-date figure and the URL of the report it was read from (201 reports; three served from the Internet Archive's captures of the ASX originals). Every month equals the modelled weekdays less closures, every FYTD equals the running sum, and the same-month-prior-year column matches the earlier report in every case. The June reports (FY totals) and the December 2009 and September 2026 brackets are preserved in this directory; the remaining monthly reports are public at the listed URLs.
